scope: packages/spa, SPA CI/spec/lockfile changes; diagnostic generated files excluded
major_findings: M-001 | Major | packages/spa/vite.config.ts:40-43 | If the development server cannot expose its effective port, /api/user falls through to Vite instead of returning the required fail-closed 503 and may produce an unsanitized or SPA response. | Send the fixed 503 response when getDevelopmentConfig() returns null; never call next() for a reserved API target.

M-002 | Major | packages/spa/src/server/proxy.test.ts and packages/spa/src/server/static-server.test.ts | CI can pass despite regressions in redirect rejection, the absolute deadline, disconnect/shutdown cancellation, inclusive 1 MiB boundaries, compressed decoded-size enforcement, encoded API dispatch, HEAD/POST behavior, or preexisting symlink rejection because these required cases are untested. | Add deterministic tests covering the proxy deadline and cancellation lifecycle, redirects, limit-1/limit/limit+1 decoded bodies including compression, and the complete security-relevant endpoint/symlink matrix.
minor_findings: m-001 | Minor | packages/spa/src/server/config.ts:78 | String.trim() removes Unicode whitespace as well as ASCII whitespace, so a token with a non-ASCII whitespace code point at either edge is silently changed contrary to the canonical token-normalization contract. | Replace trim() with explicit leading/trailing ASCII-whitespace removal and add boundary tests.
summary: Fresh read-only review did not pass. M-001, M-002, and m-001 were subsequently addressed and sent through fresh closure reviews.
